At ENGIE, we accelerate the energy transition by building reliable, secure, and scalable digital infrastructure. Our cloud platforms power the operations that keep energy flowing to millions of people every day.
We are looking for an experienced AWS Expert to join our Global Business Support (GBS) operations team. You will ensure the availability, security, and performance of our cloud environments while supporting business units across the group. Your expertise will directly impact how we deliver critical services.
 What You'll Do
 Manage and operate AWS cloud infrastructure, ensuring high availability and security compliance aligned with ENGIE Group policies.
 Deploy and administer IaaS and PaaS services, including VM provisioning and serverless architectures, in collaboration with cloud partners.
 Provide Level 1 to 3 operational support on AWS environments, Windows Servers, and Linux Servers.
 Automate infrastructure deployment and management using Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, and Jenkins.
 Monitor and supervise existing platforms using Grafana and CloudWatch, identifying and resolving technical issues proactively.
 Advise and support business units during go-to-run processes, sharing deep cloud expertise.
 Write and maintain technical documentation, including architecture files, operational procedures, and root cause analyses.
 What You Bring
 4 to 10 years of hands-on experience with AWS services such as S3, EC2, Lambda, IAM, RDS, VPC, ECS, and EKS.
 AWS Solutions Architect Associate certification (mandatory).
 Strong skills in Linux and/or Windows administration, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), and networking (DNS, security groups).
 Experience with DevOps tooling: Docker, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Terraform, CloudFormation, and JIRA.
 Familiarity with databases (PostgreSQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle) and data platforms (Databricks, Dataiku).
 Fluency in English at B2 level or above (spoken and written); French B2 is a plus.
 Ability to work in a multicultural, cross-functional team with strong communication and knowledge-sharing skills.
 On-call duty and interventions during non-working hours are required.
 What We Offer
 A competitive salary package reflecting your experience and AWS expertise.
 Career development opportunities within a global energy leader, with access to diverse and stimulating cloud projects.
 A wide variety of missions across multiple business units, technologies, and challenges.
 A friendly, collaborative team environment where knowledge sharing is valued.
 Flexible hybrid work arrangements that support your work-life balance.
 Continuous learning through certifications, training, and exposure to cutting-edge cloud technologies.
 Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. 
 If you decide to send us your personal information in order to apply for this position, please be aware of our job candidate GDPR Data Privacy Notice: https://www.engie.ro/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/ER_Nota-de-informare-Candidati.pdf .
 Our Commitment
 At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century!
ENGIE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants based on their skills, experience, and potential. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or any other protected characteristic.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process. If you need any adjustments, please let us know and we will work with you to ensure an accessible experience.
